_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Historical New Ansari sanctions network. Nine financial associates and two distinct trafficker profiles. Three financial associates were delisted in 2016. Sanctions do not prove conviction; no inference from nationality or addresses; no person-to-person edges or photos.

sources.title: Treasury Designates New Ansari Money Exchange
sources.claim: Treasury describes New Ansari as a money-laundering vehicle for Afghan narcotics organizations with activity in Afghanistan and the United Arab Emirates.

sources.title: Kingpin Act Designations
sources.claim: OFAC designated New Ansari Money Exchange as an entity on 18 February 2011.

sources.title: Afghan Drug Kingpin Charged With Financing Taliban Terrorist Insurgency
sources.claim: DOJ announced Haji Juma Khan’s arrest and indictment on 24 October 2008, alleging leadership of an Afghanistan-based opium, morphine, and heroin organization. The source does not establish a conviction.
